name: launch-copy
description: When a LAUNCH.md is written or edited, copies the fenced block under its "## 1. Pickup" heading to the clipboard at the end of the turn and says so, so starting a launch in a fresh chat is: new chat, paste, Enter. It reads the launch lane from the brief's Stamp section: for lane L1 or L3c (this chat starts the builder itself) it copies nothing and says there is nothing to paste; for L2 it copies the /compact line for this chat. It only watches: it never approves, asks, denies or rewrites a tool call, and never types into the prompt box.

mode.title: Launch copy mode
mode.description: Type exactly one of: copy (default): copy the Pickup block to the clipboard and notify. notify: only a notification naming the file, nothing is copied. off: nothing at all. Any other value counts as off (no picker on purpose: a picker would turn a typo into the default, copy).
